_about: Soundtrack construction (List 35, #345): the SA2 METHOD as a build order over #344's theme records — per-character vocal themes, a season thesis theme reprised at the finale, a strict motif economy, the OP as flagship. Construction-kit rule stated in the spec: the donor is a method, never source audio; every note, word, and performance is Mochiichao's own, produced on the pipelines named.
finaleReprise: the thesis theme is reprised AS ITSELF at #343's shared finale — the song the season opened with states what the season was about, with both campaigns' facts behind it; the reprise stages when #343's gate opens

honesty.audit: every season's delivery is checked at #75's house finish against one sentence: method debts (SA2's construction) are credited as METHOD in the credits roll, and there is no borrowed audio to credit
honesty.inputsNamed: voice-kit weights (open, MIT — the kit's own manifest), #72 instrument bank (in-house), the adaptive-music machinery; any future sample/font library is named at adoption with its licence class stated before use (open / free proprietary / paid — never flattened)

motifEconomy: battle/place/event arrangements are VERSIONS inside #344's records, composed from the subject's motif (a dojo battle cue cites the place motif AND the leader's motif — two records, one cue); no arrangement introduces a new motif for an existing subject — new musical identity is a #344 version event, never arrangement drift; #215 beds and #156 promo read the same CURRENT versions

op.flagship: the opening titles carry the thesis theme's flagship arrangement
op.length: SLOT-AGNOSTIC machinery — the owner's standing 60s/90s question stays open and neither is asserted; arrangements are cut to the bible's ruled slot, and a re-cut is a version, not a new theme

thesisTheme.lifecycle: introduced as the season flagship (OP seat) → arranged under the season's places and battles → reprised at the finale as itself
thesisTheme.record: a #344 record whose subject is the SEASON (bible entry); its brief's three facts are the season's own (what it is / wants / is hiding)
thesisTheme.slotDiscipline: a season cannot ship without the slot answered in the bible or explicitly deferred there — the deferral is a bible fact, not a pipeline gap; WHAT the point is = canon, owner's, entire

vocalThemes.pipeline: the voice kit (Chatterbox, MIT open weights — teardowns/voice-kit/) renders from Mochiichao's own cast references; instrumental realisation via #72 + adaptive-music machinery
vocalThemes.seat: one per major human (#344's casting call); the song is a version inside the character's #344 record
vocalThemes.shape: the identity brief AS the song: verse = who they are, chorus = what they want, bridge = what they are hiding — a song that skips the bridge has skipped the character
vocalThemes.voiceLaw: humans sing (humans speak); the record states whether a theme is diegetic (the character's own voice) or non-diegetic (the SA2 norm — the production's voice about them, over their scenes); creatures never sing (#344's fence)
